'''Capobeetle''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Goonbug]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Donscarab]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Shades on, world gone. Capobeetle is convinced the sunglasses bumped the rizz straight off the charts. Obviously, that calls for 100 selfies at the gym."

Capobeetle is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A green, rhinoceros beetle-like creature that stands bipedal with its arms crossed. The tips of its horns are orange-yellow. Its forewings are dark cyan, and its hindwings are transparent white. It's wearing black, triangular sunglasses.

Capobeetle's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces dark cyan and orange-yellow with purple. It also becomes a lighter shade of green.

==Evolution Trial==
Capobeetle's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Donscarab]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Capobeetle to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Why does the Capobeetle have a pointy head? Why don't you go ask it? Do you feel lucky, punk?"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Capobeetle began training for pure physical strength in order to fight back when hit. Often choose to tank incoming attacks directly with the body."
